tool.title: Sync generated README sections
tool.description: Rewrite each generated README region, and only where the README already carries that section's marker pair. Nothing outside a marked region is touched. The layer's AGENTS.md is synced too, for the `skills:index` index only: the skills the layer publishes, or, past 32 KiB, their directories with the full list in SKILLS.md.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if any section is stale; write nothing.

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Restrict to these sections. Repeated: the flag is emitted once per section.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Per section: written, unchanged, or skipped because it could not be determined.
